name: grid-lanes-stacking-alignment
source: CSS Grid 3 sections 6.3 and 6.4 stacking-range content distribution, adjacent-gap self alignment, and auto margins

expectedFail.reason: Chromium 147 and WebKit 26.4 do not redistribute an item's adjacent stacking-axis gap for align-self. Lynx implements the specified adjacent-gap alignment container.

oracleDisagreement.reason: WebKit 26.4 resolves the grid-axis auto margins; Chromium 147 centers the border box but reports zero used auto margins.
